phase_order: dev measured first; heldout measured after the dev failure analysis and any engine change it produced
honesty_note: synthetic loopback results over independently implemented fixture applications; they support no real-world generalization claim

metric_units.requests: engine observations recorded in the observation ledger (one per HTTP exchange the engine issued)
metric_units.http_requests: every request the serving stack answered, including index fetches
metric_units.tp: ground-truth defects confirmed (deduplicated: one defect = one finding)
metric_units.fp: confirmed findings matching no ground-truth defect on the instance
